BEFORE YOU RECORD

A room worth remembering.
With everyone’s permission.

You are responsible for checking whether recording is allowed under applicable laws, event rules, venue policies, and confidentiality obligations, and for obtaining all required permissions from participants and organizers. You are responsible for how you record, use, and share content. EventMemory provides recording tools; it does not determine whether your recording is permitted. Audio is stored on this device.

Keep the app visible and your device awake. Browsers can interrupt microphone access when locked or backgrounded. This MVP is not yet validated for two-hour mobile sessions.
YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE

Privacy & settings

Audio, transcripts, and notes are stored in your browser’s IndexedDB. No analytics or automatic cloud sync. Browser storage is not encrypted and can be cleared by the browser.

AI mode sends audio chunks and relevant text to OpenAI through your local backend, only when enabled with a server API key. Deletion removes this device’s records and local backend vectors; it cannot revoke data already processed by a provider.
